**Gen B – Boliden Graduate Program – Business & Finance**

Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position.  
  
**To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.**  
  
**A program designed for your future**

For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations.  
  
**Learn more at** Gen B - Boliden **how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential.**

**Find your path**

As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most. Explore the different positions below and find a path that fits your ambitions:

**Positions within Business & Finance:**

  

* Financial Controller, Boliden
* Business Analyst Smelters, Stockholm
* Business Analyst, Stockholm

Read more about the different positions here

**Who you are**

We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert.

**What you bring**

You hold the minimum required university degree, completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027.

**How to apply**

Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates.

The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage

**About Boliden**

Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint, and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us. Learn more at boliden.com.

**Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!**

Do you have any questions about your application? Please send an e-mail to genb@boliden.com. Last day to apply for this position is November 20th. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

Union information is available from Ingela Scherling, Saco +46 70 272 08 68, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70 541 83 93 or Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910 77 40 09.

If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

-

Important! If you are a current employee within Boliden you shouldn't complete the application at this site, please log on to your Workday account

jobs.title: Business Analyst – People Domain
jobs.description:
**Securitas Group**

Securitas is a world-leading safety and security solutions partner that helps make your world a safer place. By leveraging technology in partnership with our clients, we offer a broad portfolio of value-enhancing services and solutions integrated across the security value chain – from on-site services to advanced monitoring, comprehensive risk prediction and advisory services.

With around 322 000 employees in 44 markets, our innovative, holistic approach with local and global expertise makes us a trusted business partner to many of the world’s best-known companies. Benefitting from almost nine decades of deep experience and guided by our values of integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness, we create sustainable value by helping our clients optimize their operations and protect what matters most - their people and assets.

**About the role**

The Business Analyst will be part of a high-performing and international team with the goal to expand Data & Analytics solutions for our BI deliveries for all Securitas countries with the main focus in the People Domain. You will be responsible for representing and coordinating the business perspective throughout the BI delivery process. This includes obtaining, clarifying, documenting, and mapping business requirements. Continuous improvement requires a broader end-to-end perspective and close collaboration across the team. The Business Analyst will collaborate with the IT Lead BI & Analytics, other business analysts, the Data Engineer team, and the BI developer / frontend designer to align possibilities to improve the BI deliverables. Based on input from the business, the Business Analyst advises the IT Lead BI & Analytics on the capabilities required by end users and monitors the delivery process from requirement through implementation.

The Business Analyst is expected to consistently consider data privacy and security when data is accessed, transferred, or shared. The role supports the definition and implementation of appropriate data-access and security controls in alignment with Legal and relevant data-protection stakeholders.

**Responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and develop relationships with stakeholders across both IT and the business, with a particular focus on the People Domain.
* Identify and document changes required in the data model to support new BI requirements.
* Coordinate the end-to-end process from initial requirement through validation and delivery.
* Engage existing communities of expertise, including country Power Users, to identify and prioritize enhancements to the BI platform.
* Maintain regular engagement with business stakeholders to anticipate upcoming changes and their potential impact on the BI platform.
* In cooperation with the IT Lead BI & Analytics manage end-user expectations and improve the engagement in our data-driven journey
* Collaborate across the team and use the agreed DevOps tooling to maintain visibility of scope, status, dependencies, decisions, and delivery progress.
* Ensure understanding and visible implementation of the company’s core values of Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness.
* Maintain awareness of the skills and experience available within the area, identify future capability needs, and coordinate with other departments where appropriate.

And any other duties as directed by the IT Lead BI & Analytics.  
  
**Competences**  
  
Candidates may have limited direct BI/IT delivery experience, provided they bring strong operational knowledge, clear data affinity, and the ability and motivation to develop into an effective Business-to-IT interface.

* Strong business background within Securitas (or similar operational environment) with proven data affinity; experience as a key user / power user and understanding of how business processes translate into reporting needs.
* Ability to elicit, analyze, prioritize, document, validate, and manage requirements, including business outcomes, definitions, mappings, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to distinguish “needs vs. wants” and translate stakeholder expectations into prioritized, deliverable scope.
* Good understanding of BI fundamentals and dimensional data-model concepts, including facts, dimensions, granularity, business definitions, data quality, and historical behavior.
* Working knowledge of, or a strong willingness to learn, Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric, sufficient to validate deliverables with users and collaborate effectively with BI Developers and Data Engineers.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills: ability to communicate, present and influence credibly at all levels, internally and externally; able to work across different cultures and countries.
* Delivery mindset: ability to manage the process from requirement to deliverable, work in a structured way, and collaborate with multiple team members to keep track of status from start to end (incl. using DevOps tooling as defined by the team).
* Data privacy & security awareness: consistently considers data privacy when moving/sharing data and supports the implementation of the security layer as agreed with the legal department.
* Strong analytical mindset with problem-solving skills, proactive approach, and solid time management and self-management.
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, with the ability to connect reporting requirements to operational and business outcomes.

**Requirements**

Minimum Required:

* Experience in time sensitive projects / environments
* Knowledge and experience working with different cultures / countries
* Fluent in English both spoken and written. Bonus: knowledge of additional language(s)
* Ability to build relationships and fully engage with various management teams
* Skilled in cross-functional cooperation
* Be a dedicated team player
* Eager to learn
* Proactive
* Manages Self
* UK/ EU citizen or valid work permit
* Ability to travel throughout the working Area
*
